function.name: getItem
function.description: Read one stored item by sku.

sku.description: Stock keeping unit; opaque identifier, copy exactly, e.g. WH-9001

fields.description: Optional projection: subset of item keys to return; allowed keys: sku, name, binCode; omit for full record

function.name: listMovements
function.description: Return matching stock movement records and their summed quantity, optionally for one sku and/or at or after an instant. The total covers returned rows after the limit.

direction.description: Movement direction; one of: inbound, outbound, transfer

sku.description: Sku filter; omit for all; opaque identifier, copy exactly, e.g. WH-9001

afterInstant.description: Only movements at/after this instant; full instant YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM with zone Z or +HH:MM, never date-only

limit.description: Max rows to return, non-negative integer 0..50; omit for all rows

function.name: getBin
function.description: Read one storage bin by code and the items stored in that bin.

binCode.description: Bin code, copy exactly e.g. A-12

function.name: listStocktakes
function.description: List stocktakes with one result, optionally counted on a date.

result.description: Count result; one of: match, shortage, surplus

countedOn.description: Only stocktakes counted on this date; date-only YYYY-MM-DD, never a timestamp

limit.description: Max rows to return, non-negative integer 0..50; omit for all rows
